lead: A dropdown you can type into to filter. The input reuses Input and the popup reuses Select, so both match in every theme style; filtering and keyboard navigation come from Base UI's Combobox.

in-field.title: In Field
in-field.description: Inside a [Field](/field), it takes the Field's `variant` / `size` and its disabled / invalid state, unless passed on the Combobox.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: In `combobox.css` theme styles only handle the toggle button and the empty state; the input's look comes from `input.css`, the popup from `select.css`. As with every overlay, `data-theme-style` must be set on `<html>`.
styling.trigger: The toggle (arrow) button, with `data-popup-open` while open
styling.popup: The popup and the options, reusing Select's slots
